services.name: Boat Tours
services.desc: Enjoy 360º views of the mountains and learn interesting facts about the Town of Dillon and the Dillon Reservoir during a 1 & 1/2 hour pontoon boat interpretive tour of Lake Dillon. Hosted by the Dillon Marina and the Summit Historical Society, you are guaranteed to learn something about Dillon and Summit County that you hadn’t known before. Whether you're a history buff or just like the idea of relaxing out on the lake, it's a terrific way to spend a morning. Due to high demand, we offer these Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday every week from June 2nd- August 30st. We also offer them every second Saturday of June, July and August. blurb: Marina Park overlooks Dillon Reservoir and is surrounded by the Ten Mile and Gore Ranges. It offers lakeshore access, picnic tables with shades, a large updated playground, fishing opportunities, charcoal grills, and access to the Summit County Recreation Path around the lake. The Marina Park Pavilion is available for reservation and the park is open from sunrise until one hour after sunset for day use only.
extraNote: All parks are for day use only and may be used on a first come first use basis · Marina Park, Dillon Reservoir area
